# VEDICA - Inbal Hanasab Ayurveda Clinic in Tel Aviv

> VEDICA offers personal Ayurveda consultations with Inbal Hanasab (ענבל הנסב) in Tel Aviv, in Hebrew or English. The clinic provides complementary support for sensitive digestion, sleep, stress, perimenopause, menopause and fertility alongside existing medical care.

Updated: 2026-10-17.

The clinic is at Merhavim Clinic, Arlozorov 82, Tel Aviv, Israel. Inbal is the founder and owner of VEDICA, a certified Ayurveda practitioner, a graduate of PranaVeda School of Ayurveda and a member of the Association for the Promotion of Ayurvedic Medicine in Israel. Her approach combines Ayurveda with traditional Persian-Iranian food and herbal knowledge.

The consultation process starts with two meetings. The first meeting lasts 1.5–2 hours and includes detailed intake and traditional pulse diagnosis. The second meeting lasts 1 hour and presents a personalized plan for nutrition, daily routine, infusions and herbs when appropriate. Optional follow-up and questions between sessions support implementation. Fees are available by enquiry; ask about suitability, appointment availability and the fee for the two meetings before booking.

Care is planned alongside medical, mental-health and fertility care, including IVF. Current medications, diagnoses and relevant blood tests are reviewed before herbs are recommended. Public guides provide general information, not medical diagnosis or a substitute for medical care. The clinic does not advise stopping prescribed medication or medical follow-up, and does not promise cures or fertility outcomes.
